title: Repository root
description: Adds the README with a mise setup recipe and the house .gitignore, one block per tool: environment files, Claude Code local settings, File Explorer, IntelliJ IDEA, macOS, mise and Vim. Expr segments on the commit_* answers add a Personal tooling block after the environment files for the tooling kept out of git, plus paseo.json, .weft/ and .worktreeinclude, and leave the mise recipe out when mise.toml is kept out too.

content.expr:
'' if commit_skills and commit_mcp and commit_mise and commit_instructions else '

# Personal tooling
' + '
'.join([p for p, kept_out in [('/.agents/', not commit_skills), ('/.claude/skills/', not commit_skills), ('/.codex/', not commit_mcp), ('/.mcp.json', not commit_mcp), ('/.omp/', not commit_mcp), ('/.weft/', True), ('/.worktreeinclude', True), ('/AGENTS.md', not commit_instructions), ('/mise.toml', not commit_mise), ('/paseo.json', True)] if kept_out])

hooks.label: Commit the scaffold
hooks.description: First commit after every setup hook that may exist has run.
